channel.title: Thoroughbred Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Thoroughbred Daily News (thoroughbreddailynews.com)

item.title: Will Walden Joins the TDN Writers’ Room
item.description: Trainer Will Walden joined this week's TDN Writers' Room to discuss his first career Grade I win with Rhetorical in the Coolmore Turf Mile.

item.title: Spendthrift’s Ned Toffey Joins the TDN Writers’ Room
item.description: Ned Toffey joins this week's TDN Writers' Room to discuss the stacked lineup of Spendthrift Farm-owned horses pointing for the Breeders' Cup, including the General Manager's namesake, Ted Noffey, who figures to be the favorite in the Juvenile.

item.title: Brook Smith Talks Sierra Leone on TDN Writers’ Room
item.description: Brook Smith will be represented by Classic contender Sierra Leone and Juvenile Turf Sprint-bound Schwarzenegger at this year's Breeders' Cup. The enthusiastic owner joined us on this week's TDN Writers' Room.

item.title: The TDN Writers’ Room Handicaps the Breeders’ Cup
item.description: Bill Finley, Randy Moss, and Zoe Cadman handicap the Breeders' Cup races for 2025, offering their selections and analysis.

item.title: Breeders’ Cup-Winning Trainer Jose D’Angelo Joins TDN Writers’ Room
item.description: Jose Francisco D'Angelo joins this week's TDN Writers' Room to discuss not only his first, but also his second, Breeders' Cup victory. The Venezuelan trainer earned back-to-back scores on Breeders' Cup Saturday with Shisospicy and Bentornato.

item.title: Damon Thayer Talks Decoupling on TDN Writers’ Room
item.description: On this week's TDN Writers' Room, former Kentucky Senator Damon Thayer discusses where the decoupling fight stands in Florida.

item.title: Dale Romans Joins the TDN Writers’ Room
item.description: Dale Romans, a veteran trainer of the Kentucky racing circuit, joins us on this week's TDN Writers' Room to discuss his recent announcement that he will be making a run at the United States Senate.

item.title: Trevor McCarthy Discusses Jockey Struggles on Writers’ Room Podcast
item.description: Despite a successful career in which he won 1,871 races, jockey Trevor McCarthy announced his retirement in April. He admitted that he was “miserable” and that the many problems that come with being a jockey, especially one who is 5 feet, 9 inches tall, had caused him serious mental health problems.

item.title: Brad Cox Talks Further Ado, Hit Show on TDN Writers’ Room
item.description: Trainer Brad Cox joined this week's TDN Writers' Room to discuss stable stars like GII Kentucky Jockey Club Stakes winner Further Ado, 'TDN Rising Star presented by Hagyard' Cannoneer, GII Clark Stakes runner-up Hit Show and others.

item.title: TDN Writers’ Room: Best of 2025
item.description: The TDN Writers' Room saw a host of entertaining and enlightening guests in 2025. Here's a look at few of our favorites: Griffin Johnson, Terry Bradshaw, Junior Alvarado, and a collection of industry veterans who shared stories of the legendary D. Wayne Lukas.
